verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents ingesting alerts from monitoring tools via Signals (webhooks, generic webhook event source, alerting/monitoring integrations), defining Alert Rules with CEL-based conditions that route matched events to teams via Escalation Policies and On-Call Schedules, with backtesting and analytics on alert flow. This directly covers documented ingestion sources plus condition-based routing to teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of routing accuracy or breadth of supported monitoring-tool integrations beyond docs claims.
